messages:
Sasha (Finance): Heads up — invoice from Vendor Inc flagged on review for EU VAT treatment. They billed 0% VAT but their vendor portal shows a Netherlands branch. Need evidence of OSS/one-stop-shop registration or we'll need to treat as standard VAT. Invoice: INV-2026-034, EUR 23,400, VAT 0%.
Tom (Payments): putting a temporary payment hold until we confirm. flagged in AP system. :warning:
Marcos (SalesOps): vendor claims they sell via OSS and customer is EU B2C so 0% on our PO? That sounds wrong — we are the customer (B2B). Did they give a VAT ID?
Sasha (Finance): no VAT ID on the invoice. The supplier name = "Vendor Inc NL Branch" but VAT field blank. Attached PDF had only a UK registration string in footer.
Helena (Legal): If we are a taxable person (we're in DE for that entity) and supplier is EU, they should either charge VAT or show their OSS number and indicate it's intra-EU B2C via OSS. OSS is seller-side for B2C; not applicable for B2B reverse-charge. We need either: vendor VAT ID OR explicit reverse-charge wording + our VAT ID on invoice.
Sasha (Finance): annotated the invoice in AP: ````
Vendor: Vendor Inc — NL Branch
Invoice: INV-2026-034
Amount: EUR 23,400.00
VAT: 0% (blank VAT ID)
PO: PO-7890
````
Sasha (Finance): @Helena what's minimal evidence we can accept from vendor if they claim OSS?
Helena (Legal): a screenshot or export from their OSS portal isn't standard. OSS registrations are national — they'd have an OSS identifier; but for B2B we need their VAT number. Best ask them to reissue with either (a) their VAT ID and VAT charged, or (b) include our VAT ID + reverse-charge annotation (e.g., "VAT reverse charge — Article 194/EC") if they insist it's B2B and they won't charge.
vendor-inc-bot: Payment hold placed by Finance. Reason: VAT evidence missing.
Marcos (SalesOps): i'll ping vendor contact (Jules) now. quick note: they billed us at list price; sales team already offered a 10% promo earlier — could be separate issue.
Sasha (Finance): ok action list: 1) request vendor reissue with VAT ID or reverse-charge + our VAT ID 2) if vendor cannot provide within 3 business days, we treat as domestic VAT and request reissued invoice charging VAT, or ask for a credit note and new invoice. 3) Tom keeps payment on hold.
Tom (Payments): confirmed — hold stays. If vendor provides valid EU VAT ID and reverse-charge wording we'll release.
Marcos (SalesOps): ping sent: "Jules — can you provide your VAT ID or reissue invoice with reverse-charge and Redwood VAT ID? We're on payment hold until resolved."
Sasha (Finance): Jules replied in email saying "we are OSS registered in NL; we don't have a VAT ID to share; we've billed as 0%" — forwarded the email.
Helena (Legal): OSS registration alone isn't proof for a B2B 0% VAT treatment. OSS is for cross-border B2C. Ask them explicitly: do you have a VAT identification number (in NL or elsewhere)? If they provide only an OSS number, we still need an invoice showing our VAT ID or VAT charged.
Sasha (Finance): wrote back: "Please reissue invoice with either (A) your VAT ID and VAT charged, or (B) include Redwood Inference DE VAT ID (DE999999999) and explicit reverse-charge wording. If you cannot, provide a formal statement from your accounting showing legal basis for 0% treatment and OSS registration doc."
vendor-inc-bot: Vendor emailed: "We are an intermediary using OSS, not registered for VAT in NL. Can you accept our OSS reference?"
Tom (Payments): that's not acceptable for our AP. We need a VAT ID or reissued invoice.
Marcos (SalesOps): vendor asking for gross-up? they said they can gross-up and remit VAT if we prefer to pay net+VAT.
Sasha (Finance): gross-up here means they'd charge VAT on top of net. That's OK if they reissue. But if they insist on 0% without docs we can't pay.
Helena (Legal): document the ask in ticket. If they reissue with VAT, we'll pay. If they reissue with reverse-charge + our VAT ID, we can self-account for VAT. If neither, hold and escalate to procurement.
Sasha (Finance): noted. i'll open procurement escalation after 3 business days. adding slack thread to the AP ticket.
Tom (Payments): ETA: payment release blocked — will re-review once invoice uploaded with required fields.
Marcos (SalesOps): FYI i've asked Jules for a firm timeline. they said "end of week".
Sasha (Finance): thanks. marking thread: awaiting vendor reissue or VAT ID. :memo:
